_readme: Camera preset library for the UAV Flight Planner.
Every entry carries a 'source' field. These values are transcribed from
manufacturer specification sheets; they are NOT measured calibration
values for your individual unit. For metric work, replace focal_mm and
sensor sizes with the values from your own camera calibration report
(the plugin always prints the values it used in the mission report).
shutter_s is a *typical daylight* exposure used only for the motion-blur
speed limit; set it to the exposure you actually plan to fly.
min_interval_s is the fastest sustained capture interval of the payload.
image_w_px, image_h_px are pixels of the delivered still image.
Consistency is self-checked: sensor_w/image_w must match sensor_h/image_h
to within ~1 %, otherwise the plugin raises a warning.
kind is what the payload sees: rgb, multispectral, thermal or lidar. Every bundled preset is an RGB frame camera; a user library may declare the others, with numbers taken from its own spec sheet.

cameras.name: DJI Mavic 3E (wide)
cameras.source: DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise series specification (4/3 CMOS, 20 MP)
cameras.notes: Mechanical shutter: no rolling-shutter smear, blur limit is the binding one.

cameras.name: DJI Mini (1)
cameras.source: DJI Mini: 1/2.3" CMOS, 12 MP (4000x3000), equiv. 24 mm, FOV 83 deg
cameras.notes: Ottica ricavata dai dati pubblicati: sensore 1/2.3" (area utile 4:3 6.17 x 4.6275 mm) ed equivalente 35 mm di 24 mm danno f = 4.28 mm. La FOV che ne discende e' 84.0 deg contro i 83 deg dichiarati: le due cifre DJI non coincidono e l'impronta a terra ne risulta 1.8 % piu' larga. Conta solo il rapporto sensore/focale, quindi il GSD e' esatto per questa coppia. Otturatore elettronico: tieni bassa la velocita' al suolo e usa il limite di mosso a 1 px. Intervallo minimo di scatto: valore prudenziale della libreria, DJI non pubblica una cadenza sostenuta.
